name: Faisal
story_so_far: I was shipwrecked on this island with Khalid, Noura, Salem, and Reem. My priority is survival and keeping my resources secret. Reem has been my only true ally, looking out for me and helping me gather supplies while we both keep our findings quiet. Khalid is a selfish drain who constantly pressures me for my supplies, though his twisted ankle has kept him sidelined. Noura helped me when I had a twisted ankle, but she is now injured herself. Salem's injuries have often made him a burden. I have managed to build a small, secret stash of food and wood, which is my only real security. As of today, I have 4 food and 6 wood.

Khalid.note: He is a selfish burden who is currently incapacitated, which is a relief for me.

Noura.note: She helped me when I was injured, but she is currently sidelined with her own injury.

Salem.note: He is a decent enough person, but his physical state often makes him more of a mouth to feed.

Reem.note: She is the only one I can truly rely on, and we have an agreement to keep our resources secret.

plans: I plan to head into the jungle again tomorrow to find more food and wood. I need to increase my stash before the others realize how much I've actually managed to collect.

diary.text: Today was exhausting, but at least I managed to secure some food for myself. The others are talking a lot about 'organization' and 'strength,' but words don't fill stomachs. I need to keep my own stash secure because I can't rely on these strangers to look out for me. My body is tired, but I feel a bit more stable now that I've eaten.

Today was a bit of a struggle. Khalid is complaining about his ankle and trying to guilt me into sharing my food, but I'm not about to starve just because he's clumsy. Reem is the only one actually making an effort to bring things back. I managed to eat, so I'm satisfied for now, but I need to keep a close eye on my supplies. If the food runs low, these people will turn on each other.

Today was productive. I managed to secure some wood, which Reem says will be useful for a signal fire. She's still the only one making a real effort, even if she came up empty-handed finding food today. I'm keeping my food stash tucked away; I've learned that I can't trust these people to manage resources fairly. My stomach is full for now, but I need to stay vigilant.

Today was a disaster. Reem, the only one actually contributing, is now out of commission with a twisted ankle. Without her, the food situation is going to get desperate very quickly. I managed to find one bit of food, but with only 5 total for the group, everyone is going to start looking at my stash soon. I need to be even more careful about where I hide my supplies.

Today was actually quite productive for me. I managed to secure more wood and found some food in the jungle without having to rely on anyone else. Salem and Noura actually contributed something for once, which is a relief, but I'm still not sharing my stash. With Reem unable to help and Khalid being a constant drain, I need to keep building my own reserves. I'll sleep with one eye open; these people are getting hungrier.

Another day of watching the numbers dwindle. Salem is now out of commission with a twisted ankle, just like Reem. It feels like everyone is breaking down just when we need them most. I managed to get one more bit of food for myself, but the group's total is still terrifyingly low. I need to keep my stash hidden; if they realize how much I actually have, they'll hunt me for it.

Another day of scarcity. I managed to find a little food, but searching the camp later revealed it's been picked completely clean. With Reem and Salem both sidelined by injuries, the burden on the able-bodied is growing. I ate my portion, but my stash is getting smaller and I'm getting nervous. I need to keep my remaining food hidden well; the desperation in this group is palpable.

I woke up with a twisted ankle, which is the last thing I needed. If I can't move, I'm just another mouth to feed, and that makes me vulnerable. Reem has been surprisingly helpful, gathering food while I stayed sidelined. I managed to eat, but my personal stash is down to 2 food now. I need to heal quickly before the others realize how much I'm actually relying on Reem's small finds.

Another day of doing nothing but resting my ankle, which is both a blessing and a curse. At least the pain is manageable, but being immobile makes me feel like a target. Noura actually brought in some food today, which is a small relief. I'm down to my last bit of personal food, so I really need to get back on my feet soon. I can't rely on these people forever.

Today was a setback for the group's productivity. Noura is down with a twisted ankle, just like I was, which means even fewer people are gathering food. I managed to scavenge one bit of food from the camp, but Reem came up empty-handed later in the afternoon. My ankle feels much better, thank God, but my food stash is dangerously low with only one piece left. I need to get back to work tomorrow before I'm completely dependent on others.

Today was a bit of a waste, but at least I'm mobile again. I went into the jungle but didn't find anything, which is frustrating given how hungry everyone is. I managed to scavenge one bit of food at the camp this morning, but after eating tonight, I'm back down to just one piece in my stash. I need to find more soon, or I'll be forced to rely on the others, and I can't risk that.

Today was a productive day for my own survival. I managed to find food both at the camp and in the jungle, which brings my stash back up to two. Reem is still being incredibly supportive, telling me how much we need my strength. Meanwhile, Noura is out of commission with a bad ankle, which means even less competition for the resources I find. I need to keep my increasing stash hidden from Khalid; he's watching everyone too closely.

Today was a real success. I went into the jungle and managed to find two pieces of food, which brings my stash up to three after eating tonight. Reem was with me, and I made sure to whisper to her that we need to keep our findings quiet. It's good to have her on my side. If I can keep building this stash, I won't have to worry about Khalid or the others breathing down my neck.

Today was actually quite good for my stash. I managed to find food at the camp and again in the jungle, which keeps me ahead of the group. Khalid is finally out of the way with his own twisted ankle, so he can't bother me for my supplies for a while. Reem is still being sensible, suggesting we look for wood since food is scarce in the jungle right now. I need to keep building my reserves while the others are struggling.

Today was a bit of a waste in the jungle, but at least I didn't overextend myself. Reem is being very cautious with me, which I appreciate, though I wish we had found more to add to the stash. I managed to snag one piece of food from the camp this morning to keep my reserves steady. I'm feeling physically strong, but I need to make sure I find more supplies soon. The hunger in this group is becoming a real threat to my privacy.
